sources.title: Tiel-Coder-35B-A3B-MLX-oQ4e hits 121.4 tok/s in local inference ...
sources.snippet: A new quantized model, Tiel-Coder-35B-A3B-MLX-oQ4e, achieves up to 121.4 tokens per second for local inference, with decent output quality. The MTP version provides an additional 5 tok/s, though real-world testing is still needed.
